description: Adds or replaces files on a website and checks every page against the rules start_website returned. Files not sent stay as they are; delete_website_file removes one. Returns the viewUrl, keepUrl, pages, passed, and problems naming each rule a page breaks; the person can keep the website once passed is true. A website holds up to 40 files and 12 MB, with pages up to 300 KB and other files up to 2 MB.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

files.description: 1 to 40 files to add or replace. A file whose path is already saved is overwritten.

content.description: The file's text, or base64 for a picture or font.

encoding.description: base64 for pictures and fonts. Text is utf8.

path.description: The file's path from the website's root: lower-case, up to four folders deep, such as index.html, about.html, styles.css or images/shop.jpg. index.html is the home page, and the address /about serves about.html.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: save_website_files
title: Save website files
